summary: Keep child thread extraction on typed task block carriers and document rollback

schema.detail: No wire or table schema change.

compatibility.detail: Child summaries come from typed content, tool call and tool result blocks. The parent remains mounted across tab switches, and release metadata explicitly classifies rollback of the presentation-only switcher.

recovery.detail: Reverting the UI restores the parent-only conversation; existing child transcripts and parent drafts require no migration.
